info.name: 04 Database Authentication
info.description: Users, roles and permissions in MySQL. Run in order; each run registers a new user (neha + timestamp) and takes it through password change, locking, reset and administration, so the collection can be run repeatedly.

item.name: 1. Login against the database: valid, invalid, disabled, unknown
manoj (MANAGER + USER) -> union of both roles' permissions

exec: pm.test('message: Invalid username or password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid username or password"));
pm.test('message: Invalid username or password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid username or password"));
pm.test('message: Account is disabled', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Account is disabled"));
pm.test('message: Authentication is required to access this resource', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Authentication is required to access this resource"));

item.name: Register a new user -> 201, role USER, no hash in the response

exec: // a new user every run, so the collection can be run again and again
pm.test('role USER, enabled', () => { const u = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(u.roles).to.eql(['USER']); pm.expect(u.enabled).to.be.true; });

item.name: New user logs in straight away
Weak password, bad e-mail, bad username -> 400 with every field error

exec: pm.test('three field errors', () => { const m = pm.response.json().message; ['email', 'password', 'username'].forEach(f => pm.expect(m).to.include(f + ' ')); });

item.name: 3. Permissions from the database decide access
new user (USER -> EMPLOYEE_READ) reads the directory

exec: pm.test('disabled vikram is not listed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(e => e.fullName)).to.not.include('Vikram Nair'));
pm.test('message: Current password is incorrect', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Current password is incorrect"));
pm.test('message: Invalid username or password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid username or password"));
pm.test('message: Invalid username or password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid username or password"));
pm.test('message: Invalid username or password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid username or password"));
pm.test('message: Invalid username or password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid username or password"));
pm.test('message: Invalid username or password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid username or password"));
pm.test('message: Account is temporarily locked after too many failed logins', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Account is temporarily locked after too many failed logins"));

pm.test('locked, 5 attempts', () => { const u = pm.response.json().find(u => u.username === pm.collectionVariables.get('newUser')); pm.expect(u.locked).to.be.true; pm.expect(u.failedLoginAttempts).to.eql(5); });

item.name: unknown e-mail -> 202, same message, no token
new user's e-mail -> 202 + token (demo: no mail server)

exec: pm.test('message: Reset token is invalid, expired or already used', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Reset token is invalid, expired or already used"));

item.name: 7. Administration takes effect on the next request
admin gives the new user HR + USER

exec: pm.test('message: Unknown role(s): SUPERUSER', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Unknown role(s): SUPERUSER"));
pm.test('message: Account is disabled', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Account is disabled"));
pm.test('message: You cannot disable your own account', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("You cannot disable your own account"));
